description: Good Agricultural Practice (GAP) presets for xPollinator. Each preset bundles the substance toxicity and the crop exposure parameters that the BeeHaveEcotox component needs. The keys under 'params' are the .xrun parameter names that model/variant/mc.xml expects. BeeView-server expands a <GAP> id into these parameters before handing a run to xPollinator; command-line users copy the block into their .xrun file.

AppliedVegetationId.description: Vegetation class id of the treated crop (see model/core/components/data/vegetation classes.json).

FirstDayOfYearApplications.description: Earliest day of year on which an application can be drawn.

LastDayOfYearApplications.description: Latest day of year on which an application can be drawn.

ExposurePeriod.description: Days after an application during which forage from the treated patch is contaminated (ETOX_ExposurePeriodsList_patch).

ContactToxicityMean.description: Mean application rate in kg a.i./ha (ETOX_PPPContact_patch). Contact dose per bee = rate * RUD * 0.1 g.

ContactToxicityStd.description: Standard deviation of the application rate drawn per treated patch.

ConcNectarMean.description: Mean residue concentration in nectar of the treated crop (ETOX_PPPConcNectar_patch).

ConcNectarStd.description: Standard deviation of the nectar residue concentration.

ConcPollenMean.description: Mean residue concentration in pollen of the treated crop (ETOX_PPPConcPollen_patch).

ConcPollenStd.description: Standard deviation of the pollen residue concentration.

ResidueUnitDose.description: Residue per unit dose for contact exposure (ETOX_RUD). 0 switches the contact pathway off.

PlantDT50.description: Whole-plant dissipation half-life of the residue (ETOX_DT50).

ForagerOralLD50.description: Acute oral LD50 for adult bees (ETOX_Forager_Oral_LD50).

ForagerOralSlope.description: Slope of the adult oral dose-response curve (ETOX_Forager_Oral_Slope).

ForagerContactLD50.description: Acute contact LD50 for adult bees (ETOX_Forager_contact_LD50).

ForagerContactSlope.description: Slope of the adult contact dose-response curve (ETOX_Forager_contact_Slope).

LarvaeOralSlope.description: Slope of the larval oral dose-response curve (ETOX_Larvae_Oral_Slope).

gaps.label: Dimethoate (legacy xPollinator parameterisation)
gaps.source: Values hard-coded in model/variant/mc.xml and BeeHaveEcotox/template/experiment.xml before GAP presets existed.
gaps.notes: Kept so that older runs can be reproduced. DT50 of 1000 d and exposure period of 10000 d mean residues never dissipate. The toxicity endpoints (oral LD50 0.127, contact LD50 0.169 ug/bee, larval LD50 0.24 ug/larva) are the BEEHAVEecotox dimethoate reference values; the exposure side (0.4 kg/ha, residue concentrations, application window day 100-250) is the historical placeholder, not a registered dimethoate GAP.

gaps.label: Thiacloprid, apple, EU 120 g a.i./ha
gaps.source: Bayer, 'TCP info for BEEHAVE xpollinator', September 2026. Calypso EU label: 0.25 L/ha, one pre-bloom spray.
gaps.notes: Pre-bloom application as on the label (GS 55-57): window day 79-92, i.e. the two weeks before the flowering period of vegetation class 2102 in the Tarn-et-Garonne phenology (day 93-153). Exposure period 21 d, plant DT50 10 d, RUD 21 and EFSA default residue values confirmed with the document author on 2026-10-06. Standard deviations set to 10 % of the mean.
